blocks.text: 2.8 cm wavelength wale microwave saaman (Fig. 15.6) se interference pattern dekha ja sakta hai. Microwave transmitter (bhejne wala aala) dhaat (metal) ki deewar mein bane do khalaon (double gap) ki taraf rakha jata hai. Microwaves dono gaps par diffract hoti hain (mur kar phailti hain) aur aage ke hisse mein phail jati hain, jahan probe receiver (pakarne wala aala) unhein pakarta hai. Probe ko idhar udhar hilane se high intensity (zyada shiddat, constructive interference) aur low intensity (kam shiddat, destructive interference) wali jagahein milti hain. Probe ko meter se jora ja sakta hai, ya audio amplifier aur loudspeaker se, taake nateeja awaz ki shakal mein suna ja sake.

blocks.alt: Oopar se dekhi bench. Baen taraf microwave transmitter dhaat ki chaadaron (metal sheets) ki qatar ki taraf hai jin mein do tang khala (gaps) hain. Gaps ke paar daen taraf microwave probe hai jo taron se meter se jura hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.6: Microwaves se bhi interference ke asraat dikhaye ja sakte hain (kitab ki Figure 15.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Roshni ka interference dikhane ka aik tareeqa yeh hai: laser ki roshni ko do slits (bareek suraakhon) se guzarein (Fig. 15.7). Slits aik kaali slide par do saaf lakeerein hain jin ke darmiyan millimetre ke chhote hisse jitna faasla hai. Jahan roshni screen par parti hai wahan barabar faasle par roshni ke nuqton ka silsila nazar aata hai. In roshan nuqton ko interference 'fringes' kehte hain. Yahan dono slits ki lehrein in phase pohanchti hain, yani constructive interference hota hai. Darmiyan ke andhere hisse destructive interference ka nateeja hain.

blocks.alt: Peeli warning label wala laser surkh shua double slit wali sheeshe ki slide par dalta hai. Slits se aath surkh lakeerein screen tak phailti hain jahan barabar faasle par surkh nuqton ki qatar banti hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.7: Do slits se nikalti roshni ki shuaein aage ki jagah mein interference karti hain (kitab ki Figure 15.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Yeh roshan aur andhere fringes do loudspeakers wale tajurbe ki unchi aur dheemi awaz wali jagahon ke barabar hain: roshan fringe = unchi awaz, andhera fringe = dheemi awaz ya khamoshi. Hum jaanch sakte hain ke roshni waqai dono slits se screen tak pohanch rahi hai. Screen par kisi andhere fringe par nishan lagayein. Ab aik slit ko ehtiyat se dhaanp dein taake laser ki roshni sirf aik slit se guzre. Interference fringes ghaib ho jayenge aur screen par roshni ki aik chauri patti aa jayegi. Yeh chauri patti aik slit ka diffraction pattern hai. Jo point pehle andhera tha ab roshan hai. Doosri slit dhaanpein to bhi yahi hota hai. Is se sabit hua ke roshni dono slits se screen tak aa rahi hai, lekin kuch points (andhere fringes) par dono shuaein aik doosre ko khatam kar deti hain.

Laser ki jagah tez roshni wale bulb se bhi milte julte nataij mil sakte hain, lekin laser zyada aasan hai kyunke us ki roshni aik tang aur zyada tez shua (beam) mein jama hoti hai. Is mashhoor tajurbe ko Young ka double-slit experiment kehte hain, halanke Thomas Young ne 1801 mein jab pehli dafa yeh tajurba kiya to un ke paas laser nahi tha.

blocks.prompt: Roshni aur awaz ki lehron ke double-slit tajurbe ka muqabla karein.
blocks.explanation: Mushabehat: dono mein aik hi source se do coherent sources, aur jahan path difference poori ya aadhi wavelength ho wahan zyada aur kam shiddat wali jagahon ka pattern. Farq: awaz ki wavelength lambi hai, is liye loudspeakers ya gaps centimetre se metre tak door hote hain aur kaan ya microphone se pakre jate hain; roshni ki wavelength bohat chhoti hai, is liye slits ka faasla millimetre ka chhota hissa hota hai aur pattern screen par dekha jata hai.

items: 2.8 cm microwaves do gaps se: probe zyada aur kam intensity ki jagahein dhoondta hai.
Laser aur double slit: screen par barabar faasle ke roshan fringes (constructive) aur darmiyan andhere (destructive).
Aik slit dhaanpne se fringes ghaib: roshni dono slits se aati hai.
Young ne 1801 mein laser ke baghair yeh tajurba kiya.
